finding: Slovak turnover improved but remained negative as EA expanded
bullets: A net 12.83% of Slovak firms (n=242) reported falling turnover, improving by 13.39 pp from the prior wave's net 26.22%, while the EA posted a net 8.11% increase — suggesting tentative recovery signs.
A net 34.38% of Slovak firms (n=242) reported falling profits, improving by 5.42 pp from the prior wave but remaining 19 pp more negative than the EA's net 15.39% decline.
Labour costs rose for a net 78.81% of Slovak firms (n=242), easing 4.81 pp from the prior wave but still 19.85 pp above the EA's net 58.96% — squeezing margins further.
chart_subtitle: Net 12.83% of Slovak firms reported turnover decline.
